text:
nina.design: Post-moderation note from the playtest: when a run has a chain of tool calls, folks couldn't quickly identify which call had a schema problem. The full validation blocks are too heavy for scanning.

ryan.devex: I saw that too. Idea: inline micro-badges next to each call header that surface a one-line validation summary. Click expands a small transient panel with an example diff.

carlos.prod: Product concern: must not push main output down. Badges should be compact and overlay or pop a small anchored panel. Also add a 'show only runs with issues' filter in the run list.

emma.a11y: A11y checklist: badges must be keyboard-focusable, have an accessible name like "Schema validation: CartV3, mismatch" and expose aria-expanded/aria-controls. Popover must be accessible as role="dialog" or aria-modal="false" and focus managed. Announce new validation results with aria-live="polite" after run completion.

yuki.runtime: Backend plan: include `schema_fingerprint` and a lightweight `validation_summary` in the invocation payload. Example snippet we can emit (stringified): `{"status":"mismatch","short":"missing price","examples":[{"expected":{"price":123},"actual":{"price":null}}]}`. Clients show summary and fetch full diffs async.

ryan.devex: UX details: badge = [SchemaName] [icon] [short text]. Limit short text to ~16 chars. Keyboard: Enter or Space opens panel, Esc closes. If multiple badges exist, arrow keys navigate between them. Popover contains tiny monospace two-line diff and a link "Open schema inspector".

nina.design: Copy suggestions: avoid the term "raw". Use "Open JSON view". Badge label options: "OK", "Mismatch", "Partial match". Tooltip: "Schema validation: Mismatch. Press Enter to inspect."

emma.a11y: Also avoid color-only signals. Include text and an icon. Provide a visible keyboard hint in the popover footer and reference it with aria-describedby. For screen readers, ensure the popover content is read when opened; use focus trap then return focus after close.

yuki.runtime: Performance note: computing full diffs for every call is costly. We'll provide the short summary synchronously and compute full diffs on demand. Also store a compact schema blob for common fingerprints to avoid repeated transfers.

carlos.prod: Run-history enhancement: add a toggle "Show only validation issues" and a quick filter `?validation=has_issues`. This will help QA triage.

visual-bot: Visual test queued for playground run-detail badge changes: vt-20260323-21.

ryan.devex: Next steps: yuki to add `validation_summary` + `schema_fingerprint`; nina to mock badge variants and anchored popover; emma to review a11y labels; carlos to prioritize run-history filter. I'll open a small client PR once API shape is stable. Drop Figma link here when mocks are ready. :sparkles:
